svg.title: Tile setter — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as tile setter, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: Four separate floor tiles sit above a notched adhesive trowel with a raised hand grip. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: a shaved head, a rounded face.
